messages:
Owen (Design): quick design check — uploaded a new invite flow mock where the roles matrix is collapsed into an accordion per-team. Thoughts on discoverability + a11y? link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/invite-flow Maya (PM): liking the tighter layout. question: will new users know to expand the team to set roles? maybe we need a CTA 'set roles' instead of just an arrow. Kat (Frontend): perf note — rendering 200+ roles per org will blow up the DOM if we render full table. can we virtualize rows or lazy-render when expanded? :thinking_face: Sam (Eng): +1 to virtualization. also the current CSS uses box-shadow on each row which hurts paint. suggest using border + transform for hover. Priya (Accessibility): contrast nit: role chips don't meet 4.5:1 in the dark theme when selected. also keyboard users can't tab into the role dropdown inside the accordion without two extra keypresses. Owen (Design): good catches. For the 'set roles' CTA: intended pattern was a small secondary button. maybe it should be primary on empty state. what about adding 'roles assigned' summary line when collapsed? e.g., "3 roles assigned" to improve scannability. Maya (PM): summary line sounds great. helps support our metric of fewer invite reversal support tickets. Kat (Frontend): for virtualization I can switch to react-window for the row list + a portal for dropdowns to avoid overflow clipping. that should also reduce the paint thrash. Sam (Eng): + implementation detail: if we portal dropdowns out of the accordion, we need to manage focus & aria-owns. sample snippet for aria: ```
  • Org Admin
``` Make sure aria-expanded toggles and focus moves into the listbox. Priya (Accessibility): code looks fine but listbox pattern expects arrow key handling. also tabindex="0" on the list makes it focusable but not necessarily announced as a listbox by some screenreaders unless role is set correctly. add aria-label or aria-labelledby. Owen (Design): UX question: SSO toggle currently sits inside org settings > security. Some PMs worry it's too buried. Should we surface a small toggle on the invite drawer that says "Require SSO for invite" (disabled for non-admins)? Maya (PM): we want to avoid putting security-critical toggles in a transient drawer. maybe surface a link: "SSO & access settings" that opens the org security page, and then show a one-line indicator in the drawer: "SSO required: On" with a tooltip explaining how to change. Priya (Accessibility): tooltip timing: the experimental tooltip had 300ms delay on hover which anecdoted to parity issues with keyboard focus. prefer immediate on focus and a 200ms on hover; ensure it uses role="tooltip" and aria-describedby when triggered by keyboard focus. Kat (Frontend): small CSS ask: the role chips should have a 2px solid focus ring (not outline) when keyboard focused. easier to animate and meets contrast. Owen (Design): microcopy tweak: change "Org Admin" to "Organization admin (full access)" only in the role-details panel — keep the compact label as "Admin" in condensed views. reduces truncation but clarifies in expanded view. Maya (PM): SGTM. Also can we have an audit-log jump link from the role detail to "View invitations & audit" that anchors to the audit table and filters by user? reduces support handoffs. Sam (Eng): backend: we already have an audit query param ?filter=user:email. frontend can just open /orgs/:id/audit?filter=user:foo. needs permission check though. Owen (Design): navigation nudge: add a small breadcrumb-like link under role details: "View audit →" (opens in same tab). makes sense? Priya (Accessibility): confirm the link has descriptive text for screenreaders: "View audit log for role assignments for {team}" instead of ambiguous "View audit". Kat (Frontend): action items I can pick up: 1) implement virtualization + portal, 2) add focus styles, 3) wire the audit link. estimate 2-3 days. Owen (Design): I'll update the figma: add collapsed summary line + 'set roles' CTA + audit link mock. also add a11y notes on the frame. Maya (PM): i'll update the ticket and set priority P1 for the a11y contrast + keyboard bug. file: TICKET-4312. UXBot: reminder: design review scheduled Thu 10am — please bring keyboard nav demo and aria checklist. :calendar: Owen (Design): thanks all. I'll post updated mock here when done. :thumbsup:
